description: A limited list of plugins selected and tested for Kaint.

photocraft.name: Film Emulation Toolkit
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Applies compact film-inspired color looks with deterministic grain.

photocraft.name: Detail Recovery
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Reduces small noise and restores local detail with lightweight spatial filtering.

photocraft.name: Color Toolkit
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Adjusts exposure, contrast, and saturation while preserving alpha.

photocraft.name: Gradient Map & Duotone
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Maps image luminance to a selectable two-colour gradient while preserving alpha.

photocraft.name: Mosaic Pixelate
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Creates block-based pixelation with adjustable block size and intensity, preserving alpha.

photocraft.name: Vignette
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Adds a soft, adjustable edge darkening with a smooth radial falloff while preserving alpha.

photocraft.name: White Balance
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Corrects warm/cool color casts and green/magenta tint with lightweight channel gains.

photocraft.name: LUT Studio
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Applies bundled 3D LUTs in PhotoCraft; companion browser studio imports custom .cube files and exports images or video frames.

photocraft.name: Geometry Fixer
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Straightens rotation and corrects horizontal or vertical perspective with adjustable zoom, preserving alpha.

photocraft.name: Seamless Pattern Generator
photocraft.author: ArtCraft Store community
photocraft.description: Reduces visible tiling seams by smoothly blending opposing image edges while preserving alpha.
